issues.issue: Whether the new affidavit, brother's statement, neighbour's statement and news articles are admissible
issues.applicant_position: Brother's new statement is more detailed, confirms threats and clarifies omissions.
issues.result_text: All new evidence arose before rejection or was reasonably available; inadmissible.

issues.issue: Whether an oral hearing should be granted
issues.applicant_position: Appellants request an oral hearing and explain why it is needed.
issues.result_text: No admissible new evidence, so no oral hearing under IRPA s.110(6).

issues.issue: Whether the panel member showed a reasonable apprehension of bias
issues.applicant_position: RPD's credibility findings were made with a clear apprehension of bias against the claimant.
issues.result_text: Panel's questioning was appropriate; no reasonable apprehension of bias on balance of probabilities.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in faulting PA for not explaining omissions in her brother's 2017 statement
issues.applicant_position: RPD's position was unduly microscopic; PA did not write the statement and cannot explain the omission.
issues.result_text: RPD held her to an unreasonable standard; the omission does not undermine overall credibility.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in drawing a negative inference from relocations not listed in Schedule A
issues.applicant_position: Appellants contest the RPD's finding on relocations.
issues.result_text: Discrepancy is not material; the negative credibility finding is unwarranted.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD was right to give the police report no weight
issues.applicant_position: RPD disregarded the police report without valid reason; PA never ruled out XXXX as sender of the messages.
issues.result_text: RPD did not err in weight given to the police report, though for different reasons.

issues.issue: Whether the appellants are persons in need of protection under s.97 IRPA
issues.applicant_position: PA believes XXXX threatens her because she caused confiscation of his assets; the minor's risk is the same.
issues.result_text: Appellants are persons in need of protection under s.97(1)(b) IRPA.
